title: Microsoft Purview: Classifier Simulation Mode for custom classifiers
summary: The roadmap dates, default availability and existing creation and editing controls are supported. Hold the briefing because the uploaded-file testing advice omits an Exchange Online licensing prerequisite and the location given for the new simulation controls is not documented. The effect of automatically disabling a classifier also needs to remain an open question rather than a stated mechanism.

Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/sit-sensitive-information-type-learn-about. Do not apply this prerequisite to the new Classifier Simulation Mode.

claims.fix: Replace the checklist bullet with 'Check the Microsoft Purview compliance portal for the new simulation option and classifier health insights as the preview and general availability rollouts complete.' MC1185445 supports the portal location but not the Classifiers sublocation.
